model.weight_hash_verification: pending separate host receipt; blob filename is not a verification

protocol.reported_corpus: guide corpus; exact file/prefix/tokenization not found
protocol.named_harness_finding: graft routing experiment; no perplexity calculation
protocol.recovery_harness_finding: WikiText or local-doc fallback; six cached-chunk windows and 511 targets; NOT original receipt protocol
protocol.resolution: A separate create-only protocol amendment must pin recovered original source, token file, token SHA and exact scoring convention BEFORE any model gate. No synthetic, WikiText or alternate-doc substitution.

c_delta.scope: one global delta per bitwidth; pooled eligible query-key pairs over all 62 layers at S=1024; frozen for S=8192 and decode
c_delta.selection: B actual native diagnostic masks give target fraction. Fixed grid [0,32] step 1/128 on B activations gives initial delta; ties choose smaller delta. Up to 8 actual C calibration forwards, fraction only, bisection with bounds 0,32; first actual fraction within 0.01 freezes delta. If none match, RED; no PPL-based tuning.

e_delta.eq: upward-rounded float32 maximum |scale*q dot reconstructed_k - scale*q dot original_k| over ALL eligible keys, heads, queries, layers in B/C at BOTH lengths. If any layer missing E blocked.
e_delta.scope: finite activation envelope, not a universal proof for E activations; verify E error max separately

g2.scope: all eligible bottom-right causal query-key pairs, no sampling
g2.exact_scores: float64 dot of the captured BF16-representable Q/K, scale=96**-0.5
g2.bulk_scores: same float64 dot with reconstructed BF16 kq; also record runtime rounding difference when available
g2.quantiles: exact nearest-rank order statistics, float32 storage; report rounding in receipt
g2.mass: dense exact softmax probability mass of unrefined keys; weight ratio exp(s_j-max(s)); no omitted-key interpretation
g2.split: one layer per analysis job; activation and native selection capture separate from timing; replay does not supply timing

g3.protocol: identical teacher-forced continuation tokens, cached expanded MLA for all arms; absorbed_decode=False; no generation divergence confound
g3.timing: wall with synchronization before and after each token; prefill excluded
g3.trained_window_boundary: 32 decode steps at S=32768 exceed trained context; report as extrapolation, never trained-window quality

safety.foreign_process_policy: abort on other compute PID; never signal it
safety.resume: only PASS receipts with current registration, protocol, build, harness and dependency hashes; RED receipts stop, no automatic retry

lead_predictions.P2: C within 0.05 ppl of B at matched fraction
lead_predictions.P3: E fraction >=0.95, real eq >=0.8, E ppl within 0.01 of A
lead_predictions.P4: bulk4 p99 error <0.5*max; C skipped weight ratio >0.1 on some layer while ppl unmoved (P2 tolerance)

seat_predictions.S1: G0 likely RED on current engine even after tokens recovered; documented matmul/softmax drift exceeds 0.01
seat_predictions.S2: D likely differs from A by >0.005 ppl: BF16 cuBLAS/softmax rounding differs from fused FP32 accumulation
seat_predictions.S3: E fraction >=0.95 at bulk4; conditional finite bound will not establish general low-precision usefulness
seat_predictions.S4: C within 0.05 of B if realised fraction matches; skipped weight ratio >0.1 likely
seat_predictions.S5: C/B full-model decode at S=32768 <2 because latent expansion, re-quantization and INT4 projections remain in both arms

stop_conditions: D incorrect or not all selected
C actual fraction mismatch after registered trials
OOM or deadline reached: RED row, no alternate path or relaxed threshold

prior_art.BLASST: Yuan et al. 2025/2026, arXiv:2512.12087: running-max log threshold; APA promotes individual keys instead of omitting blocks
prior_art.ThriftAttention: Sharratt 2026, arXiv:2605.23081: selective precision and weight-sensitive error motivation; no FP4 tensor-core implementation port
prior_art.FlashAttention-2: Dao 2023, arXiv:2307.08691 and Milakov/Gimelshein 2018 online normalizer: stable online softmax/work partitioning; existing SP implementation reused, no FA2 port
prior_art.TurboQuant: Zandieh et al. 2025, arXiv:2504.19874: rotation and scalar codebook via existing quant.py; reconstructed BF16 keys, no QJL residual or packed FP4 arithmetic
prior_art.APA: David Perry 2026, docs/APA_PAPER_DRAFT.md: all-key denominator, |bulk| z selection and precision promotion
prior_art.SP2: existing conditional log(1/epsilon)+2eq proof; here model finite max measurement, no new universal theorem
prior_art.SP3: new experiment wiring, global model calibration, captured-activation tail audit and fail-closed receipts; empirical percentiles and matched-control experiments are standard, no novelty claimed
